training.old: R2/R4/R5 route-heldout, exact fit_memory/fit_all from pinned run.py
training.new: all old R2/R4/R5 training only; canonical T2 sensors, seed0

decision.SUPPORTED_BUT_LIMITED: fraction of case-bias conditions with MEMORY heading RMSE > 1.10*POWER1 <= 0.10 AND fraction with strictly improved heading95 > 0.50
decision.counting_unit: 16 cases times four biases, no independence or p-value claim

canonical_gate: Test all recovered implementations; if multiple pass, identify numeric discrepancy before proceeding. If only impl1 source is available and passes actual-engine math tests, canonical designation is bounded to available source. Impl2/3 remain BLOCKED_INPUT and untested; report-derived reconstruction is documentary only.
oracle_use: unit simulation and sensor generation/scoring only
trace_storage: NPZ Actions artifact; code and <=20MB summary CSV committed; source/input hashes and run/artifact IDs in MANIFEST.json

posthoc_validity_20261020.reason_ko: 구현1/canonical의 현재 지위는 검증된 실행 기준이다. 구현2·3은 DEFERRED_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE이며 원본 비교·동등성 검증을 완료한 것으로 간주하지 않는다. 파일명 CANONICAL_RESULTS.csv와 역사적 정본 표기는 원문 식별자로 보존한다.
